text.tspan: one amplitude per octave, nearest-neighbour coupling, N retained shells clamped at both ends
A. The ladder of retained shells, with clamped ends
nearest-neighbour coupling only: shell k feels k−1 and k+1
increases to the right → smaller scales
B. Zoom: shell k is fed by k−1 and drained with k+1
C. Truncation regularizes: the transfer cancels
internal fluxes cancel pairwise; the end fluxes are killed by the clamps
the transfer term is identically 0 — for every sign pattern
D. Where the regularity comes from — and where it stops
no finite-time blowup for e ≥ 0, ν > 0, any κ
unbounded; E no longer dominates enstrophy
genuine blowup scenarios live beyond the truncation
The transfer is even in u, so this cancellation is sign-blind: no schedule of sign flips creates an energy source. The sign-sensitive object is the e = 1 enstrophy budget (SignReversal.lean).
